findings.mitigation_in_demo: The browser demo plays this clip at 50% volume and labels it. That reduces loudness only; it does not fix the mismatch. The original native-audio file is unchanged.
resolution_options: Re-render with explicit audio cues (no frothing; low cafe ambience) under a live, cost-capped, human-approved run.
Replace the track in post-production with licensed or approved audio, keeping the native original as evidence.

findings.source: Foundry Evals brand_marks (3 repeats) + agent visual check of the approved PIM image (not human review)
findings.observation: The grader answered violation, consistent, consistent. The violation cites the catalog rule 'CONTOSO PRO wordmark on yellow housing', but the approved drill PIM image is black/teal. The reference image and the written brand rule conflict.
findings.handling: Shown as 'split', not majority-voted into approval. The historical catalog is unchanged. A brand owner must decide which source is authoritative.

findings.source: original @brand-qa (direct vision) vs Foundry Evals product_identity (two-stage)
findings.observation: Original QA scored product fidelity 0.18 (fail). The two-stage evaluation judged identity 'match' 3/3 from text observations. Text observations can miss visual detail that direct frame scoring caught, or the original score may be too strict.
findings.handling: Neither verdict overrides the other. Review the full clip against the reference image.
